text: Professional positioning and core goalsBiological Sciences is a fundamental discipline that studies life phenomena and their laws, covering multi-level life systems from molecules and cells to individuals and populations. Its core goals include:Revealing the essence of life: such as the mechanism of DNA replication, cellular signal transduction pathways, and the laws of brain neural development;Analysis of Biodiversity: Adaptive Evolution from Deep-sea hydrothermal microorganisms to Tropical Rainforest Flora and FaunaPromoting medical and agricultural innovation: Research on the mechanism of cancer occurrence, exploration of crop stress resistance genes;Addressing Global Challenges: Analysis of the Mutation Patterns of the Novel Coronavirus, Biosecurity Prevention and control (such as the invasion of alien species).
